message:
Last week, we had a little surprise blackout, and I couldn't help but chuckle at my gloriously over-prepared self. While others were scrambling for flashlights, I confidently strolled to my trusty lantern stash in the closet. I even had freshly charged power banks at the ready to keep our phones alive for the important stuff — yes, like scrolling through my favorite shows! 

As I settled in with a cozy blanket and glowing lights, I realized that being prepared doesn’t just mean having gear; it’s about creating a sense of calm when the unexpected happens. 

Anyone else out there a proud member of the over-prepared club? What’s your favorite tip for staying comfy during a power outage? 😊
